pages.title: Built-in String Methods
pages.content: Strings come with many useful methods: `upper()` converts to uppercase, `lower()` to lowercase, `strip()` removes whitespace, `replace()` swaps characters, and `split()` breaks a string into a list.

pages.title: Common Methods
pages.code:
msg = "  Hello, World!  "

print(msg.strip())         # "Hello, World!"
print(msg.upper())         # "  HELLO, WORLD!  "
print(msg.lower())         # "  hello, world!  "
print(msg.replace("World", "Python"))
# "  Hello, Python!  "

words = "one,two,three".split(",")
print(words)  # ['one', 'two', 'three']
